messages:
eval-bot: Nightly eval alert for pset_18 on redwood-v2-small-quant: contrast_f1 dropped 6.4 pts vs baseline. Failing cases ↑ from 12 to 89. Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/2412345678 :rotating_light:

sam: ugh. did anything land to promptset_18 yesterday? :eyes:

maria: yep, PR 4823 landed ~22:15 UTC — removed the 'contextualizer' prefix from examples to simplify phrasing. small diff attached.

maria: ```diff
- Q: Contextualizer: Is the device compatible with X?
+ Q: Is the device compatible with X?
- A: Contextualizer: The answer is...
+ A: The answer is...
```

tj: that sounds like it could increase false positives (positively phrased Qs boost acceptance). did we re-run locally with the new pack?

maria: i ran a quick smoke over 100 cases — small change. the nightly has many more generated examples though, looks like quantized model variant exposes the skew.

devon: confirmed on dedicated canary: redwood-v2-small-quant yields higher acceptance on borderline negatives. attaching a short trace: `trace_id=canary-241234`

aria: hypothesis: by removing the 'contextualizer' anchor we removed a subtle negative framing which the promptset relied on for calibration. when combined with post-training quant noise, model drifts toward shorter/affirmative completions.

sam: can we reproduce deterministically? tj/devon — can you run this exact command and paste the top 10 failing cases?

tj: running now: `python -m eval.run --pset pset_18 --model redwood-v2-small-quant --seed 42 --limit 500 --report-id canary-241234`

maria: also note: we recently merged a tokenization tweak in tokenizer v1.3 (PR 4789) that slightly changes spacing around colons. could interact with the prompt text.

devon: tj results: 10/10 cases show answers flipping from "no" -> "yes" on the prefixed vs non-prefixed prompt. sample: 

sam: paste one example please

 tj: "Q: Is the device compatible with X?
A: The device is not compatible with X." -> model outputs: "Yes, it is compatible."

aria: oof. suggests the contextual prefix carried negative cue tokens. options: revert promptset change, rebaseline (accept new semantics), or add explicit negative qualifier to neg cases.

sam: quick triage plan: 1) tj+devon run deterministic reproducer and upload failing traces (by EOD). 2) maria to open a rollback PR for promptpack v2.1 guarded behind nightly canary gate. 3) aria to evaluate adding targeted negative anchors to pset_18 and run small canary.

maria: opened rollback PR 4830 — it reverts only the contextualizer removal so we can compare. cc @devon @tj

devon: running the rollback canary now on dedicated, will post numbers in ~30m :thumbsup:

tj: if rollback fixes >90% of new fails we should merge revert and plan rebaseline later with more controlled evals.

aria: agree. rebaseline will be noisy; prefer revert + small promptfix iteration to avoid shipping regression.

sam: thanks. set a reminder to re-run full nightly after revert merge and keep this thread updated. :eyes:
